filter: STRICT USDT linear perps only (folders ending USDT/; exclude dated, inverse-USD, USDC, and all *PERP USDC-settled). Corrected per D3 and INFR-010 §6 A1.
history_cap: MAX 4 YEARS trailing per symbol (amended 2026-07-14). Long symbols use trailing 4y for processing + fence.

storage_estimate.peak_raw_in_flight: one day-file (memory only; discarded after aggregation)
storage_estimate.note: ZERO permanent raw (incl. BTC/ETH/SOL — keep-forever deferred to MBP INFR). Peak = one file in flight. 4y cap. Final Parquet single-digit GB target.

pipeline_model: download-decompress-aggregate-in-stream -> Parquet staging -> discard ALL raw (zero permanent)
